meta.title: How your photo is used
meta.description: What happens to your photo, how long it is kept, who can see it, and how to remove it.

gate.eyebrow: One thing before your first try-on
gate.title: How your photo is used
gate.intro: Read this, then decide. Nothing is ticked for you, and you can stop here — browsing the collection never needs a photo.
gate.staleTitle: We've changed how your photo is handled
gate.staleIntro: You agreed to version {previous}. Version {current} is what applies now. Read what changed and confirm to carry on trying pieces on.

points.purposeTitle: Your photo is used for your try-ons and nothing else
points.purposeBody: It is sent to the service that produces the try-on image, together with the studio photo of the piece. It is not used to advertise anything, and it is never shown to another shopper.
points.providerTitle: The processing service deletes it straight away
points.providerBody: The service that generates the image deletes your photo as soon as the try-on is produced, and does not use it to train anything.
points.retentionTitle: We keep your photo for {photoDays} days after you last use your account
points.retentionBody: After that it is deleted automatically. You can delete it yourself at any time, without asking anyone.
points.retentionRendersLifetime: Your try-on images stay with your account for as long as you keep it, so revisiting one never costs you another try-on. You can delete any of them individually.
points.retentionRendersLimited: Your try-on images are kept alongside your account and you can delete any of them individually.
points.staffTitle: Studio staff cannot see your photo
points.staffBody: Not on any screen, at any time. They see a try-on image only when you send an enquiry and attach it yourself.
points.controlTitle: Delete my photo and results — always one tap away
points.controlBody: It lives in your account menu on every screen from here on. Deleting is immediate for you and complete in our systems within 24 hours.

gate.checkboxLabel: I've read this and I'm happy for my photo to be used to generate my try-ons.
gate.declineNote: The collection, search, filters and every piece stay open to you without a photo.

granted.title: Agreed
granted.description: Recorded on {date}, version {version}. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your photo and results.

deleteControl.label: Delete my photo and results
deleteControl.hint: Removes your photos and every try-on image from your account.

errors.title: The policy didn't load
errors.description: We won't ask you to agree to something you can't read. Try again.
errors.CONSENT_POLICY_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't load the current policy. Try again shortly.
errors.RESOURCE_CONFLICT: The policy changed while this page was open. Reload to read the current version.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Tick the box to record your agreement.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in to record your agreement.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and we'll bring you back here.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is on hold. Contact the studio and we'll sort it out.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: That's a few attempts in a row. Give it a minute and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You appear to be offline. We'll record your agreement when you're back.
errors.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: We're briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Your agreement wasn't recorded. Try again — we've been notified.
